verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents RESTful CRUD endpoints for reading and writing records, and a bulk write API that can insert, update or upsert up to 25,000 records per call with job-completion callbacks. Change detection is covered by notification channels, including field-level triggers, and API limits are tracked through a credits header. Missing for 10: concrete rate-limit and concurrency figures (only the remaining-credits header is evidenced), and independent or hands-on corroboration of sync at scale.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync records bidirectionally through the API at scale, with documented rate limits, upserts, and change detection

citations.quote: Perform CRUD operations on CRM module entities and integrate with any third party application through flexible RESTful endpoints.
This API allows you to insert, update, or upsert a maximum of 25000 records in a single API call.
Get notified whenever a data change occurs inside your CRM. Eliminate sending polling requests to check for data changes.
the remaining credits (including add-on credits) will be present in the header X-API-CREDITS-REMAINING in the API response.
An asynchronous API, used to push or retrieve large amounts of data to and from Zoho CRM, through a single API call.
